probe.proof:
by
  let g : (n : ℕ) → ℕ → Fin n → Fin n → ℤ := fun _ k i j => (i.succ : ℤ) + j.succ - k
  let v : ℕ → ℕ → Prop := fun n k => 0 < n ∧ 0 < k ∧ ∃ f : Fin n → Fin n, f.Injective ∧ Set.range (fun i => g n k i (f i)) = Set.Icc (1 : ℤ) n
  refine ⟨g, v, ?_⟩
  intro he
  have hl := he.mpr (by constructor <;> intros <;> rfl)
  have hv : v 1 1 := by
    dsimp [v]
    refine ⟨by decide, by decide, id, Function.injective_id, ?_⟩
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst i
      norm_num [g, Set.mem_Icc]
    · intro hx
      change (1 : ℤ) ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1 at hx
      have hx' : x = 1 := le_antisymm hx.2 hx.1
      subst x
      exact ⟨0, by norm_num [g]⟩
  obtain ⟨_, _, f, _, hf⟩ := (hl.2 1 1).mp hv
  have hm : g 1 1 0 (f 0) ∈ Set.Ico (1 : ℤ) (1 : ℕ) := by
    rw [← hf]
    exact Set.mem_range_self 0
  norm_num at hm
